purpose: Create business-neutral file metadata, immutable content-version identities, upload sessions, resource links, operation receipts and transactional lifecycle Outbox facts.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema and empty tables only.
dataImpact: No binary content, CRM attachment type, retention rule, provider location, credential or production policy is seeded.
recovery: Retain immutable file and link history when rolling application code back; restore only before first use.
forwardFix: Before first application this reserved migration may be corrected during review; after application use a new reviewed forward migration.
